---
title: "Overall survival — primary diagnostics"
subtitle: "Compact posterior diagnostics for 50 Bayesian survival fits"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This stage reports compact convergence diagnostics and refuses to certify a
branch that violates the configured thresholds. It does not re-fit models or
write patient-level displays.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
model_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "models")
diagnostic_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "diagnostics"))
result_path <- project_path("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "diagnostics.parquet")
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: check-os-models
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  output_path <- file.path(diagnostic_dir, sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(model_path)) stop("Missing OS model branch: ", model_path)
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-os-diagnostics-%02d", index),
    input_paths = model_path,
    output_paths = output_path,
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "overall_survival", imputation = index),
    worker = function() {
      model <- readRDS(model_path)
      if (!requireNamespace("posterior", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'posterior' is required for OS diagnostics.")
      draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(model)
      diagnostics <- as.data.frame(posterior::summarise_draws(draws))
      diagnostics$imputation <- index
      finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
      finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
      finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]
      if (length(finite_rhat) == 0L || any(finite_rhat > config$diagnostics$max_rhat) ||
          length(finite_bulk) == 0L || any(finite_bulk < config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk) ||
          length(finite_tail) == 0L || any(finite_tail < config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail)) {
        stop("OS posterior diagnostics failed for imputation ", index, ".")
      }
      module_save_parquet(diagnostics, output_path)
    }
  )
}
diagnostic_paths <- file.path(diagnostic_dir, sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", indices))
if (!all(file.exists(diagnostic_paths))) stop("OS diagnostics are incomplete.")
all_diagnostics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(diagnostic_paths, module_read_parquet))
module_save_parquet(all_diagnostics, result_path)
```
